access_note: Quarterly NAS is published only for base years 2011-12 and 2022-23. The 2011-12 Back series is annual only (1950-51 to 2011-12), so it cannot extend the quarterly record. Growth splicing across the two bases is required for use.

Four base-year vintages chained by overlapping months: 1993-94 (1994-04 to 2011-06), 2004-05 (2005-04 to 2017-03), 2011-12 (2012-04 to 2026-03), 2022-23 (2023-04 to 2026-09). No internal month gaps; 1994Q1 missing.

source: MoSPI Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) monthly
access_note: Monthly PLFS starts April 2025 (month_code 1-3 for 2025 return no rows). Too short for the gate; not a substitute for the quarterly series.

source: MoSPI Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) quarterly
access_note: Quarterly PLFS starts 2018Q2 (2018 returns Apr-Jun onward). 2025Q1 is absent. No continuous pre-2018 all-India quarterly series; pre-2017 stays missing under Q-09 (no backcasting).

PLFS quarterly indicators cover LFPR (1), WPR (2), UR (3) and worker distribution (4). No quarterly total-hours or hours-worked series was found in MoSPI NAS, IIP, PLFS or the RBI API catalogue. Missing stays missing.

PLFS wage-earnings indicators (codes 6-8) are annual, not quarterly. No quarterly household disposable-income series was found. Annual values are not disaggregated (C-06) and do not satisfy a quarterly core indicator.

source: MoSPI NAS Private Final Consumption Expenditure (PFCE)
access_note: Same quarterly NAS constraint as GDP: 2011-12 and 2022-23 bases only; the Back series is annual. A price index such as CPI is not a volume/expenditure substitute.

No official monthly retail sales index covering the window exists in the MoSPI product list (NAS, CPI, IIP, PLFS, ASI, HCES, NSS rounds) or the RBI API catalogue. Card, GST e-way-bill and auto-sales proxies are barred by Q-03. The 2026 Index of Services Production trial is too recent and is not a retail series.

source: MoSPI NAS Gross Fixed Capital Formation (GFCF)
access_note: Quarterly GFCF is total only. Adding institutional_code 1, 2, 6 or 9 returns "No Data Found", so no quarterly business/non-residential split exists under Q-02. Total GFCF is not an acceptable proxy.
